facts.text: The Jefferson started life as a luxury apartment block in 1923.
facts.excerpt: A jewel among historic hotels in Washington DC, The Jefferson started life as a luxury apartment block in 1923.

facts.text: The building was designed by architect Jules Henri de Sibour in the Beaux-Arts style.
facts.excerpt: Designed by architect Jules Henri de Sibour in the stunning Beaux-Arts style

facts.text: By 1955 the apartments had been transformed into a hotel.
facts.excerpt: by 1955, the apartments had transformed into a hotel for the most discerning travelers.

facts.text: During the renovation, a lobby skylight that was part of the original design and hidden since World War II was recovered.
facts.excerpt: one of the most exciting discoveries during the renovation was the recovery of a magnificent skylight in the lobby. Part of the original design but hidden since World War II

facts.text: The building was renovated from top to bottom over two years.
facts.excerpt: spent two years renovating it from top-to-bottom, infusing modern elegance and historical influences into the stately structure.

facts.text: The Jefferson reopened as a reborn hotel in 2009.
facts.excerpt: In 2009, The Jefferson was reborn, becoming a renowned hotel in the nation’s capital

facts.text: The First Lady Suite is a top-floor suite with city views and three Juliette balconies.
facts.excerpt: This simply charming top-floor suite offers dramatic views of the city, accentuated by three Juliette balconies.

facts.text: The First Lady Suite has a gas fireplace, an intimate dining room and a canopied King-size bed.
facts.excerpt: thoughtful details like the gas fireplace, intimate dining room and canopied King-size bed

facts.text: The Presidential Suite overlooks the Washington Monument and downtown DC from five Juliette balconies.
facts.excerpt: Host an intimate dinner party or small cocktail reception overlooking the Washington monument and downtown DC from five Juliette balconies

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a private kitchen and a private study.
facts.excerpt: From the private kitchen to the private study, discover true luxury in the heart of Washington.

facts.text: The First Lady and Presidential suites include a complimentary one-way transfer to any regional Washington, DC airport, with 24 hours' notice.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary one way airport transfer to any regional Washington, DC airport (24 hour advance notice require, up to four people)

facts.text: Suites include twice-daily housekeeping.
facts.excerpt: Twice-daily housekeeping

facts.text: The Book Room surrounds guests with leather-bound books as a place to relax in privacy.
facts.excerpt: here our guests are surrounded by leather-bound books, to relax, and get privacy.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as pet-welcoming, with special amenities for dogs.
facts.excerpt: We’re not just ‘pet friendly’, we’re ‘pet-welcoming’.

facts.text: The fitness center has cardio equipment including two Pelotons and a TRX Training Center.
facts.excerpt: Our residential fitness center features state-of-the-art cardio equipment including, 2 Pelotons, elliptical machines, treadmills, and a TRX Training Center.

facts.text: Guests have access to an expanded fitness center and pool at the University Club.
facts.excerpt: All guests have access to the expanded fitness center and pool located at the University Club.

facts.text: For every room booked, the hotel sponsors a children's book for the DC Public Library's Books from Birth program, with Dolly Parton's Imagination Library.
facts.excerpt: For every room booked, we sponsor the purchase of a children’s book for the DC Public Library’s ‘Books from Birth’ program, in collaboration with Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library.

facts.text: The hotel offers a local historian.
facts.excerpt: Local Historian

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the White House.
facts.excerpt: Seasonal dining and weekend brunch beneath a restored historic skylight in Washington, DC, steps from the White House.

facts.text: The Greenhouse serves seasonal dining and weekend brunch beneath the restored historic skylight.
facts.excerpt: Seasonal dining and weekend brunch beneath a restored historic skylight in Washington, DC, steps from the White House.

facts.text: Quill pairs cocktails with live piano and has private cabinet rooms and a cigar-friendly patio.
facts.excerpt: pairs expertly crafted cocktails and live piano in one of Washington DC's most intimate and sophisticated bar settings, with private cabinet rooms and a cigar-friendly patio.

facts.text: Private event spaces include The Book Room, The Private Wine Cellar, The Parlor Boardroom and The Gallatin Room.
facts.excerpt: A birthday dinner in The Private Wine Cellar.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the most awarded hotel in Washington DC.
facts.excerpt: as the most awarded hotel in Washington DC, our guests seem to agree.

facts.text: Quill is rated as one of DC's best cocktail bars.
facts.excerpt: Rated as one of DC’s best cocktail bars, Quill offers classic and signature cocktails, wine and an elevated bar menu.

facts.text: The Jefferson is an independent hotel.
facts.excerpt: An independent, iconic landmark in the nation’s capital.
